audit_items.proof_trace: The function returns nil (0 sidecars) when cellsAndProofs is empty (line 125-127), violating the spec requirement to always produce NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS sidecars. The loop at line 218 only executes when cellsAndProofs is non-empty, creating a path where the invariant len(output)==NUMBER_OF_COLUMNS fails.
audit_items.attack_scenario: A block producer creates a valid block with zero blob commitments. When DataColumnSidecars processes this block, it returns nil instead of 128 empty sidecars, causing downstream consensus code expecting a fixed-size array to fail or misprocess the block.
